function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the customer's identity before any loan, EMI, overdue amount, payment, or debt information is disclosed. This is the mandatory authentication gate. Only verified=true allows Maya to disclose account details.

account_id.description: The customer's account identifier. For this assessment use ACC-88392.

verification_code.description: The verification code provided verbally by the customer.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Records a confirmed Promise-to-Pay after the customer explicitly agrees to pay. Do not call until the customer has clearly confirmed both the payment amount and payment date.

amount.description: Amount the customer explicitly committed to pay in INR.

ptp_date.description: Customer's promised payment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

account_id.description: Customer account identifier. Use ACC-88392 for this assessment.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a mock payment link to the customer's registered contact channel after a valid payment commitment or when the customer requests the payment link. This tool does not process a payment.

account_id.description: Customer account identifier. Use ACC-88392 for this assessment.

channel.description: Channel through which the mock payment link should be sent.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalates the customer to a human collections agent when the case requires human handling, such as a debt dispute or financial hardship. Do not use this tool for routine Promise-to-Pay cases.

account_id.description: Customer account identifier. Use ACC-88392 for this assessment.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Records the final outcome of the collection call. This must be called before ending every completed conversation so that the call has an auditable disposition.

account_id.description: Customer account identifier. Use ACC-88392 for this assessment.

notes.description: Short factual summary of the outcome. Do not include unnecessary sensitive information.
